description: Helps you decide who else must agree before a deal can close. You give what you sell, the deal size, the company size, your champion and any stakeholders you know. You get a buying group map with your stakeholders placed by their titles (economic buyer, technical evaluator, reviewers, users), each role's concern and message prompts, an influence map and discovery questions, with sector roles and questions when your inputs name a supported sector. Roles from titles are hypotheses to confirm. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of impact_identify_champions when you need a deal buying-group map covering budget, technical and review roles.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

confirmed_budget_owner.description: Optional confirmed fact: the person or role who owns the budget for this purchase. Ask the user; do not infer from title. Overrides candidate ordering. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

known_stakeholders.description: Roles you know are involved. A title suggests a role, not confirmed authority. Confirm who owns this purchase budget. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["finance director and procurement lead"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "finance director and procurement lead".

product_category.description: What you sell. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

target_company_size.description: Company size (e.g., "500-1000 employees"). Format is text.

typical_champion.description: Your typical champion role. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

name: buyer_group_analyzer
